name: ECON 2201
title: Intermediate Microeconomic Theory
description: Intermediate microeconomic theory, covering demand and supply, exchange and production, pricing, and welfare economics.
requirement_description: ECON 1200 or 1201 or ARE 1150; MATH 1071Q or 1110Q or 1120Q or 1125Q or 1131Q or 1151Q or 2141Q. Recommended preparation: ECON 1202. Not open for credit to students who have passed ECON 2211Q or 3441.
